title: Lesson 54 - The Review That Changed My Mind

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Which booth were you planning to book?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The Courtyard Booth. The review that worried me said the Street Booth was “impossible to use for calls.”

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Who wrote it, and when did they use the room?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: A reviewer who held a call there at four thirty on a Friday. They heard delivery carts outside for twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's a specific experience, but “impossible” sounds broader than the evidence.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Another reviewer who used the same booth on Tuesday morning said it was quiet and the wired connection was stable.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: So the two reviews may describe different times rather than a contradiction.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The room where the first person had trouble faces the loading area. That part can be checked.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What does the official facilities page say?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: It confirms a wired connection and a delivery window from three to five on weekdays.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What about the Courtyard Booth?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: It is farther from the loading area, but it uses Wi-Fi only. One person called it perfectly reliable after a single Sunday visit.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: That's one person's experience. It doesn't prove the connection is always reliable.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Right. My presentation is on Tuesday at ten, which is outside the delivery window.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Which detail matters most for your call?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: The wired connection. I have to share a large visual file, and the call only lasts forty-five minutes.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: Then the review that changed your mind didn't give you the answer; it helped you find the delivery schedule.

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Exactly. Based on the details that matter to me, the Street Booth is the better fit for Tuesday morning.

lines.speaker: Maya
lines.text: What needs to happen next?

lines.speaker: Aisha
lines.text: Here's what we agreed with the workspace: I own the booking, due by five today. It depends on the booth still being available, and the only open point is whether I need an adapter for the wired port.
